content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Veridia Payments was compliant with all three financial covenants on the Venture Term Loan for the period ended October 31, 2026, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculations on each. The most notable change is that the cushion on the Minimum Unrestricted Cash covenant has narrowed each month since August, to {{fact:8e3cc6ee-3f32-4372-8ffa-b56474e37f7b}} at October month-end. Unrestricted cash of {{fact:6e1f9945-aca3-4aff-92b9-e5fc64446651}} remains above the {{fact:a7dc4d4b-e463-4f7e-b37b-0776585b1b49}} floor.
